selection_policy: Current generation first, not update timestamps alone
Small older generation only when no verified same-size successor and with explicit reason
Publisher performance claims are not local quality proof
Special decision models outside general chat catalog
Server models hidden unless actually feasible
No runtime fork downloads or major migrations implied by curation
removed_primary_models: DeepSeek-R1 and all original R1-Distill-Qwen/Llama entries
preserved_benchmark_evidence: Old tested models stay in local result history; no badge/score transfer to new versions.
small_system_policy: Prefer tested compact LFM2.5 2.6B configuration as qualification candidate; current-generation alternatives retained for comparison.
metadata_policy: Read-only publisher metadata; no weights downloaded or inference performed.
